name: tavolozza
description: Pick which plugins are on for this project, from inside the session: /tavo writes the choice to .claude/settings.local.json.

startup.title: When to show at session start
startup.description: always: open the pane every session. first-visit: only in folders without a profile. on-change: also when installed plugins changed since the profile was saved. never: only /tavo.

palette.title: Palette view
palette.description: Draw the picker as a painter's palette. Off: a plain list (better with screen readers).
